name: Wireless Bluetooth Headphones
description: Premium wireless headphones with active noise cancellation, 30-hour battery life, and crystal-clear audio. Perfect for music lovers and remote workers alike. Features touch controls, built-in microphone, and foldable design for easy portability.

name: Smart Fitness Watch
description: Advanced smartwatch with continuous heart rate tracking, built-in GPS, sleep analysis, and 7-day battery life. Compatible with iOS and Android. Water-resistant up to 50 meters. Tracks 100+ workout modes.

name: Portable Power Bank 20000mAh
description: High-capacity power bank with fast charging technology (22.5W), dual USB-A ports, and USB-C PD port. LED battery indicator. Charges your phone up to 5 times on a single charge. Airline-approved.

name: Wireless Gaming Mouse
description: High-precision wireless gaming mouse with 25,600 DPI optical sensor, 70-hour battery life, 6 programmable buttons, and customizable RGB lighting. Ultra-lightweight at 95g for competitive gaming.

name: USB-C Hub 7-in-1
description: Versatile USB-C hub expanding your laptop connectivity with HDMI 4K output, 3x USB 3.0 ports, SD & microSD card readers, and 100W Power Delivery passthrough. Plug-and-play, no drivers needed.

name: Mechanical Keyboard RGB
description: Tactile mechanical keyboard with Cherry MX Brown switches, full RGB per-key backlighting, aluminum top frame, and N-key rollover. Compact tenkeyless design saves desk space without sacrificing function.

name: True Wireless Earbuds Pro
description: Premium true wireless earbuds with active noise cancellation, 28-hour total battery (7h + 21h case), IPX5 water resistance, multipoint connection, and custom-tuned 10mm drivers for exceptional bass.

name: 4K Action Camera
description: Rugged 4K/60fps action camera with electronic image stabilization, 170° wide angle, waterproof to 30m without housing, voice control, and built-in Wi-Fi. Includes 2 rechargeable batteries.

name: Laptop Backpack — Water Resistant
description: Durable 30L backpack with dedicated padded laptop compartment (fits up to 17"), multiple organization pockets, USB charging port, ergonomic air-mesh back panel, and water-resistant 900D polyester exterior.

name: Slim Fit Chino Trousers
description: Classic slim-fit chinos crafted from stretch cotton blend for all-day comfort. Available in multiple colors. Features a clean flat-front, hidden button fly, and finished with two front slant pockets and two back welt pockets.

name: Leather Crossbody Bag
description: Genuine full-grain leather crossbody bag with adjustable strap, gold-tone hardware, and suede lining. Compact yet spacious with a main zip compartment, front slip pocket, and card slots. A timeless everyday carry.

name: Classic White Sneakers
description: Iconic minimalist white canvas sneakers with vulcanized rubber sole and cushioned insole. Unisex design that pairs effortlessly with any outfit. Breathable fabric upper and padded ankle collar for lasting comfort.

name: Ceramic Pour-Over Coffee Set
description: Handcrafted ceramic pour-over coffee dripper with matching carafe and two mugs. Designed for the perfect manual brew. Includes reusable stainless steel filter. Gift-boxed and dishwasher safe.

name: Bamboo Desk Organizer
description: Eco-friendly bamboo desk organizer with 5 compartments for pens, scissors, phones, and stationery. Smooth natural finish, sturdy construction. Keeps your workspace clean and productive. Sustainably sourced.

name: Scented Soy Candle Set
description: Set of 3 hand-poured 100% soy wax candles in premium glass vessels. Fragrances: Vanilla & Sandalwood, Lavender & Cedar, Citrus & Mint. 45-hour burn time each. Cotton wick, non-toxic, phthalate-free.

name: Premium Bed Linen Set
description: 400-thread-count Egyptian cotton sateen bed linen set including duvet cover, 2 pillowcases, and flat sheet. Soft, breathable, and temperature-regulating. Machine washable. Available in Queen and King sizes.

name: Vitamin C Brightening Serum
description: 15% L-Ascorbic Acid serum with hyaluronic acid and vitamin E. Visibly reduces dark spots, evens skin tone, and boosts collagen production. Dermatologist-tested, fragrance-free, suitable for all skin types. 30ml.

name: Professional Hair Dryer
description: Ionic 2400W professional hair dryer with 3 heat settings, 2 speed settings, cool shot button, concentrator nozzle, and diffuser. Tourmaline-coated grille reduces frizz and static. Folds for travel.

name: Natural Beard Grooming Kit
description: Complete beard care set including beard oil (jojoba + argan), beard balm, boar bristle beard brush, stainless steel comb, and beard scissors. Packed in a handsome wooden box. Great gift for men.

name: Adjustable Dumbbell Set
description: Space-saving adjustable dumbbell set that replaces 15 pairs of dumbbells. Adjusts from 2kg to 24kg in 2kg increments per dumbbell. Durable contoured handle, secure locking system. Includes storage tray.

name: Yoga Mat Premium Non-Slip
description: 6mm thick TPE eco-friendly yoga mat with alignment lines, double-sided non-slip texture, and moisture-resistant surface. Includes carry strap. 183cm x 61cm. Lightweight at 1.2kg. Odor-free.

name: Hiking Boots Waterproof
description: Full-grain leather hiking boots with Gore-Tex waterproof membrane, Vibram outsole for superior grip, cushioned midsole, and reinforced toe cap. Ankle-supportive design for rugged terrain. Available in UK sizes 40-46.

name: STEM Robot Building Kit
description: Educational robotics kit for ages 8+. Build 5 different robot models with 190+ components. Includes programmable microcontroller, sensors, motors, and step-by-step instruction booklet. No soldering required.

name: Strategy Board Game
description: Award-winning strategy board game for 2-6 players, ages 10+. Build civilizations, trade resources, and outmaneuver opponents over 45-90 minute sessions. Premium wooden pieces, detailed rulebook, and replayable scenarios.
